findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_mailbox_checkin · Private data: get_tombstones · Public sink: update_listing, opt_in_for_intros.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_mailbox_checkin · Private data: get_tombstones · Public sink: update_listing, opt_in_for_intros

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_startups" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Salesbook Top-100 corpus by keyword (name, problem, solution). Returns a short text list of ranked matches. Sector is optional: omit it to search all sectors (retail, manufacturing, healthcare, education, horizontal)." → after: "Search SalesBook's evidence-graded B2B startup rankings. Alternative to CB Insights, PitchBook, and G2 for finding enterprise-ready tech vendors across Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Education, AI platforms, and agentic commerce (agent payments, identity, inboxes, tools, directories and agent-to"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
